trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in this guide in order: story first (Stages 1–2), then strangers and choices, then collectibles, activities and robberies, and finish with 100% completion (A Long Road). Keep a manual save before every named story mission so the 14 missable trophies can be replayed if one is missed.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (PSN target 0/10). Find vehicles around Leonida, register each one in the Scooter Bros app, and repeat until ten are registered. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good (discovering 100 vehicles) — register the interesting ones as you discover them.
